description: 津波断層モデル(8)初期水位データ [tsunami and earthquakes] (series on G-spatial Information Center) is a series of datasets listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター). 令和7年に公表された「首都直下地震モデル・被害想定手法検討会 地震モデル報告書」に基づくデータです。 (8)初期水位データ 問い合わせの際には、問い合わせフォームの「ご意見、ご感想」記入欄の冒頭に【震度分布・浸水域等に係るデータに関する問い合わせ】とご記入ください。 データのダウンロードは、ユーザ登録の後、 ログイン状態で行ってください。. Coverage: Japan. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The datasets are filed under 3 publishers. Its tags are 関東地方, 首都直下地震. It offers 9 resource(s) in 7z, pdf, zip. The portal shows 2025-12-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is the data owner's own terms of use (see the dataset page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
